clusters.name: Nindoru Fiends (the campaign's signature foes)
clusters.scene: Unholy living fiends born when an oft-reincarnated evil soul is torn from the cycle of souls and corrupted. They wield broken-yet-functional weapons, manifest objects/creatures from thought (blood-red butterflies = thoughts), and savor souls that reincarnated many times (all SoG PCs qualify). Shared: darkvision, immune death effects, weakness silver 5 (except argyrzei), resist void 5, and Soul Shred (auto-counteract resurrection/animation of their kills). Kugaptee, buried under the Tan Sugi, is the apex.

fragments.plot_point: MEOKDAN (Hungry Nindoru) C2 RARE. AC 17; Fort +5 Ref +9 Will +9; HP 32; weak silver 5, resist void 5. bone club +10 (1d6+6 B) / shattered bone club (1d4+6 S +1 bleed) / bite +10 agile (1d4+6 P). Occult DC 18: item facade, illusory disguise, phantom pain, telekinetic projectile. Manifest Bone Club; Snack crit-bite heals 1d8+8. Soul Shred +7 rank 2.

SOJIRUH (Shrieking Nindoru) C4 UNCOMMON. Most common; mouth stitched with hair, ribcage of butterflies. AC 17 (21 w/Manifest Armor); Fort +8 Ref +11 Will +13; HP 58; weak silver 5, resist sonic/void 5. broken shortsword +14 agile/finesse (1d6+7 S +1d6 mental). Occult DC 21: item facade, noise blast, shatter, fear, ventriloquism, figment. Ruin Wielder. Stolen Scream (DC 21 Fort, up to 8d6 mental + frightened 3; heals 2d8+8). Soul Shred +11 rank 2. Xin Yue reincarnates into an elite sojiruh.

GUHDGGI (Wandering Nindoru) C5 RARE LARGE. Frog-body, human arms, second throat-face, wicker cage. AC 21; Fort +13 Ref +9 Will +14; HP 80; weak silver 5, resist void 5. broken spear +14 reach 10 (2d6+6 P +1d6 mental); hair lash +13 agile (2d6+6 + Grab). Occult DC 22: slow, wanderer's guide, item facade, enfeeble, daze. Belch Butterflies (15-ft cone DC 22 Reflex, up to 8d6 S+bleed+sickened). Cage Prey (2d4+6 mental/rd, DC 22 escape). Lurching Skewer. Soul Shred +13 rank 3.

IJDA (Forgetful Nindoru) C6 RARE LARGE. Headless (butterfly cage), broken katana, mindless guardian. AC 23; Fort +15 Ref +13 Will +12; HP 100; weak silver 5, resist mental/void 5, immune emotion/sleep/fatigue. broken katana +17 reach 15 (2d6+8 S +1d6 mental, deadly d8). Occult DC 24: phantom pain, shatter, item facade, stupefy, sure strike, daze. Aura of Forgetfulness 30 ft (DC 21 Will, slowed). Manifest False Memories (DC 21 Will, stupefied+confused). Soul Shred +14 rank 3.

KAGEKUMA (Lurking Nindoru, 'shadefiend') C8 RARE. Hides as a faceless laborer; bundle = severed lives. AC 25 (27 w/bundle); Fort +15 Ref +16 Will +18; HP 135; weak silver 5, resist void 5. kusarigama +19 reach (2d8+7 S +1d6 mental) / bite +18 reach 10 (2d6+7 P +1d6 mental). Deception +18 (+20 as peasant). Occult DC 26: rewrite memory, translocate, fear, veil of privacy, blur, item facade. Shadow Bite (DC 26 Fort, drained). Shed Bundle. Soul Shred +16 rank 4.

AKASHTI (Sobbing Nindoru, 'copycorpse') C10 RARE. Wears a dead loved-one's body to infiltrate grieving homes. AC 29; Fort +17 Ref +21 Will +19; HP 175; weak silver 10, resist void 10. claw +21 agile/finesse (2d6+11 S +1d6 mental). Occult DC 29: illusory creature, wave of despair, honeyed words, phantom pain, talking corpse, item facade. Manifest Body (10-min corpse disguise, +4 Deception if it eats the body). Stunning Despair (30 ft DC 29 Will, stunned 1/3). Soul Shred +19 rank 5.

SHISAGISHIN (Crooked Nindoru) C12 RARE. Lantern-head, disguises as a corpse and bursts to life at funerals. AC 33; Fort +22 Ref +25 Will +20; HP 214; weak silver 10, resist void 10. claw +25 agile/deadly d6/finesse (3d8+7 S +1d6 mental + Grab). Occult DC 32: vampiric exsanguination, illusory scene, vision of death, blood vendetta (at will), item facade. Reactive Strike. Burst From Death (pre-initiative claw). Manifest Corpse Shell (Deception 44). Spread Decay (DC 32 Fort, up to 6d8 void + enfeebled). Soul Shred +21 rank 6.

ARGYRZEI (Headless Nindoru) C13 RARE. Backward feet, blade-stuffed neck; RESISTS silver 10 instead of weak, weaponizes cursed silver. AC 34; Fort +23 Ref +24 Will +21; HP 240; resist silver/void 10. silver blade +28 two-hand d12 (2d8+11 S +1d6 persistent bleed +1d6 mental). Cursesense (1 mile via cursed silver). Occult DC 33: phantom pain, dominate, illusory scene, subconscious suggestion, illusory disguise (at will), item facade. Infect Silver (DC 33 Will; fused silver = clumsy 1 + -2 saves vs nindoru mental; 5 active). Manifest Silver Blade. Soul Shred +23 rank 7.

SECRET - KUGAPTEE is a nindoru DEMIGOD ('nindoru ascetic') buried beneath the Great Sugi, sealed ~1000 yrs ago by hero Tan Sui-Jing (whose soul reincarnated as the sealing tree). His striving for rebirth is the source of every monster, haunt, and mindscape. Full stat block lives in the dungeon/Act-4 slice; here he is the apex of the nindoru entry. Withhold name/nature until the PCs learn it.

clusters.name: Noppera-bo (faceless yokai)
clusters.scene: Faceless deceivers who look human from behind until they turn. No Face: no vision but precise hearing, don't breathe (immune inhaled/olfactory/visual), weakness sensitive hearing (deafened -> slowed 1); they steal/wear faces. The deadliest variant, the IMPERSONATOR, is a manifestation of Kugaptee's power inside Heh Shan-Bao's mindscape - monstrous copies of the PCs themselves.
clusters.gate: noppera-bo impersonators only appear inside Heh Shan-Bao's mindscape (Act 4)

fragments.plot_point: NOPPERA-BO GRUNT C0 UNCOMMON. AC 15; Fort +6 Ref +5 Will +4; HP 18; immune inhaled/olfactory/visual, weak sensitive hearing. spear +7 / +5 thrown (1d6+1 P). Impersonate Shape (faceless copy of a touched humanoid, +2 Impersonate). Minion-tier.

NOPPERA-BO TRICKSTER C1 UNCOMMON. AC 16; Fort +7 Ref +8 Will +5; HP 20; immune inhaled/olfactory/visual, weak sensitive hearing. shortsword +8 agile (1d6+1) / shortbow +8 deadly d10 (1d6). Deception +8. Impersonate Shape gains face+voice (loses No Face/immunities while faced). Remove Face (DC 17 Will, frightened). Sneak Attack +1d4.

NOPPERA-BO OCCULTIST C2 UNCOMMON. AC 17; Fort +6 Ref +9 Will +8; HP 30; immune inhaled/olfactory/visual, weak sensitive hearing. staff +7 (1d4+3 B). Occult DC 18: fear, phantom pain, sleep, daze, figment, prestidigitation, read aura, shield. Remove Face (DC 18). Steal Face (1/day DC 18 Fort: on fail takes the victim's face, victim blinded/mute/holds breath).

SECRET - NOPPERA-BO IMPERSONATOR C6 RARE. Faceless monstrous DUPLICATES of the PCs, born of Kugaptee's thought-energy in Heh Shan-Bao's mindscape; gear is illusion (shifts to broken props when slain). AC 22; Fort/Ref/Will +14; HP 93; immune inhaled/olfactory/visual, weak sensitive hearing. false weapon +15 (2d8+8 MENTAL only). Build per-PC via role: MARTIAL (+2 atk/dmg, +3 Fort/-3 Will, options Armored AC24/Reactive Strike/Shield/Weapon Perk), SKILLED (+3 Ref/-3 Fort, +2 skills, options Commander minion/Elemental Attack 4d6 DC24/Sneak Attack/Weapon Perk), SPELLCASTING (+3 Will/-3 Ref, innate DC 24 +16 in matching tradition). Can also replace NPCs for years.

clusters.name: Named Campaign NPCs (allies, villains, power-brokers)
clusters.scene: Principal characters the PCs negotiate, ally, or duel with: two elders vying for interim governor (Granny Hu / Old Matsuki, both Influence targets), the tragic governor Heh Shan-Bao (man -> Act-4 yohoi murderer), ghost-hunting lumber baron Mago Kai, jorogumo princess and key ally Ren Mei Li, undead priestess of Kugaptee Xin Yue, and benevolent founding ghost Zhi Hui (the expositor). Several carry the campaign's central revelations.
clusters.gate: Granny Hu / Old Matsuki Influence open once Willowshore is safe (Ch.3); Mago Kai parley Act 3; Xin Yue/Zhi Hui at the Tan Sugi monastery

fragments.plot_point: GRANNY HU BAN-NIANG, Unique C5, retired guard captain & blackmail-broker; pushes Northridge (defenses up, winter food down). AC 20; Fort +10 Ref +10 Will +13 (+1 vs fear, Nerves of Steel); HP 75. longsword +13 (2d8+3 S). Influence 3rd-lvl: Discovery DC 18 Perc/16 Society/14 Underworld Lore; Influence DC 14 Willowshore Lore/16 Crafting(tea)/16 Intimidation/18 Diplomacy/20 Deception; bribery/criminal-past +2 DC; food-fears -2 DC. Reactions Want to Try Me?/Are You Sure? (DC 22 Will). So Have You Heard? (1/day reputation hit). Blackmail backfires.

OLD MATSUKI SHOU, Unique C5, ~99-yr carpenter & Southbank spokesman; pushes Southbank (winter food up, defenses down). AC 18; Fort +10 Ref +8 Will +12; HP 70. staff +11 (2d4+4 B). Cataracts -2 visual Perc; You Know They Say (Willowshore Lore for Recall Knowledge -2 w/ Dubious Knowledge). Influence 3rd-lvl: DC 14 Willowshore Lore/16 Alcohol Lore/16 Diplomacy/18 Deception/20 Intimidation; 'trust youth' +2 DC; shared meal bonus. Drinks each round (DC 15+ Fort or passes out). A Drink for Good Luck; Respect Your Elders! (DC 22 Will, stupefied); Wait Give Me a Moment.

MAGO KAI, Unique C11, ghost-hunting lumber baron of Sze; Act 3 truce Q&A (DCs ~26-31). Satisfactory answers: <=2 attacks; 3-4 deal (turns off warding bell, keeps logging); 5-6 leaves (possible Act-4 ally). AC 29; Fort +24 Ref +18 Will +21; HP 220; Reactive Strike. battle axe +24 sweep (2d8+11 S +1d6 persistent bleed +2d6 spirit). headbutt +22 agile/nonlethal; hatchet +19 thrown. Ghost Killer (ghost touch, +2d6 spirit vs incorporeal/transmigrated PCs). Carries Karahai key + bell ringer.

REN MEI LI, Unique C16, jorogumo PRINCESS of Willowshore; pragmatic benevolent ruler secretly aiming for the throne of Yin-Sichasi. Key ally Ch.12; avoids fighting PCs (charm/suggestion then translocate/Silver Mistwalk). AC 39; Fort +28 Ref +31 Will +25; HP 295; weak peachwood 15, resist poison 20. jaws +27 (3d12+14 P + venom DC 37 Fort, up to paralyzed) / claw +27 agile / web +23 range 60 (DC 37). Occult DC 37: charm, suggestion (x3), summon spiders, outcast's curse (x3), mind probe, mind reading (at will), translocate. Change Shape; Silver Mistwalk (1/hr teleport in domain). Darting Legs.

SECRET - XIN YUE, Unique C7, polite undead PRIESTESS OF KUGAPTEE who engineered the monastery's fall and works to revive him; retains memories across 115 yrs; fights to the death while Kugaptee's presence remains. AC 25; Fort +11 Ref +13 Will +17; HP 90 void healing; immune bleed/death/disease/paralyzed/poison/unconscious. shortsword +16 agile/finesse (2d6+6 P +1d6 persistent bleed). Field of Past Regrets aura 40 ft (living non-nindoru gain weakness 3 mental). Divine spontaneous DC 25: divine wrath, fly, harm, dispel magic, crisis of faith, vampiric feast, command, fear, enfeeble, sanctuary. Chastise Heretic (counteract divine spell). Near-Death Experience (DC 25 Will). PROFANE REINCARNATION: at 0 HP reborn as an elite sojiruh. Withhold her allegiance until revealed.

ZHI HUI, Unique C7, benevolent GHOST and founder of the Tan Sugi monastery & Willowshore; the campaign's KEY EXPOSITOR. Once her four statues are purified she answers questions, casts spells, and aids combat at purified-statue areas, then fades after Xin Yue is beaten in Kugaptee's Grave. AC 23; Fort +11 Ref +15 Will +17; HP 85 rejuvenation/void healing; incorporeal, resist all 5 (except force/ghost touch/spirit/vitality). ghostly hand +15 agile/finesse (2d8+7 void). Divine DC 25: life's fresh bloom, cleanse affliction, heal (x3), clear mind, sound body, sanctuary, stabilize. Incarnate Skill (1/character skill swap).

SECRET - HEH SHAN-BAO, the tragic GOVERNOR. As a man (Unique C9, p.353): corrupt-but-not-cruel exile whose backfired ritual let Kugaptee consume him and cast Willowshore into two mindscapes. AC 25; Fort +15 Ref +18 Will +16; HP 135. longsword +17; Scroll Esoterica/Thaumaturgy (9 daily scrolls, DC 28 +20, any tradition); Reflecting Ward (2/day resist 10). Encountered un-rescuable in Act 3 (reveals the escape path). THEN in Act 4 becomes a YOHOI brainchild (Unique C13, p.356): AC 35; Fort +24 Ref +25 Will +21; HP 180; weak sonic/mental 15, resist physical 15 (except silver); Fear of Flutes; Frightful Presence 100 ft DC 30. illusory claws +26 reach 10 (4d8+10 mental +1d6 S). Occult DC 33: phantasmal calamity, spirit blast, vision of death (x3), translocate, shatter. STEAL SOUL (kills via those spells leave eyeless/emaciated/wrist-branded un-resurrectable victims). Murder clues: Missing Eyes DC 22, Emaciated DC 25, Wrist Runes=Kugaptee DC 27, Cause of Death DC 22. Withhold his guilt + transformation until earned.

clusters.name: Other Tian Xia Spirits & Creatures of the campaign
clusters.scene: Supporting bestiary entries that populate Willowshore's haunts, the Specterwood, ruins, and the mindscape - pulled by location/theme: cat-spirits, faceless undead, curse-fey, light-eaters, home-spirits, town guardians, grass-undead, and the soul-reaping shinigami / Pharasma's apostate path maidens.

fragments.plot_point: ALGRIEVER C9 UNCOMMON, spider-spirit guardian of forgotten shrines. AC 27; Fort +15 Ref +17 Will +21; HP 155. fangs +19 agile (2d12+7 P + venom DC 28 Will, mental+stupefied) / web +19 (DC 28). Shrine Bond; Acolyte's Defense reaction. Divine DC 28: crisis of faith, dispel magic, divine wrath (x3).

BAKENEKO C3 RARE, flaming cat-spirit that animates corpses to dance (nekomata = C6 variant). AC 20; Fort +8 Ref +7 Will +4; HP 35; weak cold iron 5, resist fire 5. claw +10 agile (1d8+5 S). Cat at Heart; Feel the Beat; Flammable (fire -> bursts aflame +1d6 fire). Occult DC 20: summon dead (zombie), daze, figment; create undead ritual (zombie).

DALGYAL GWISHIN ('Faceless Horror') C5 UNCOMMON INCORPOREAL UNDEAD. Masked spirit of a lonely death; steals faces; enemy of noppera-bos. AC 21; Fort +9 Ref +15 Will +12; HP 58 void healing; lifesense 120 (no vision); resist all 5. head +12 finesse (2d6+2 B +2d6 mental). Frightful Presence 30 ft DC 19. Jealous Frenzy (1/day vs higher-Cha). Peel Face (DC 22 Will, stupefied; takes face).

IMPRECASIA ('curse eater') C11 UNCOMMON FEY drawn to curses. AC 31; Fort +18 Ref +23 Will +21; HP 180; immune cursed, weak cold iron 10, resist void 10. Scent Curse. claws +23 agile/finesse (2d12+9 S + homeland's hostility). Drink Death reaction. Primal DC 30: blindness, cleanse affliction (curses), deafness, mirage, earthbind, tangle vine. Devour Curse; Homeland's Hostility (DC 30 Will, difficult terrain).

PATH MAIDEN (masc = path nomad) C12 RARE INCORPOREAL UNDEAD, Pharasma apostates (reached via Gossamer Sash). Typical: AC 31; Fort +18 Ref +22 Will +24; HP 160 void healing; resist all 10. apostate's shroud +21 agile/finesse (3d10+8 mental; failed Fort -> cursed -> ghost if killed). Imprisoning Grave aura 30 ft. Limited flight (max 10 ft). Occult DC 32: phantasmal calamity, spirit blast, illusory scene, wave of despair, outcast's curse, translocate. Pick 2 specials (Scorn Fate, Vengeful Frenzy, Blasphemous Aura, Corrupting Doubt, Sour Strike).

SHIMMERTHIEF C7 UNCOMMON BEAST, blind light-eating cave lizard. AC 25; Fort +12 Ref +17 Will +15; HP 119; immune blinded/dazzled/visual; echolocation 120. jaws +17 (2d8+10 P) / claw +17 agile (2d6+10 S). Gleam Theft aura 10 ft. Primal DC 25: darkness (at will), blur. Drain Light (counteract light, heal). Lasting Darkness (1/day 24-hr). Unnerving Shriek (60 ft DC 24 Will, frightened/fleeing).

SHINIGAMI C17 UNCOMMON MONITOR, soul-reaper of stubborn kami-souls. AC 40; Fort +32 Ref +29 Will +31; HP 260 fast healing 40; immune death/disease/void, weak silver 15, resist physical 15 (except silver)/cold 15/poison 15; truesight; Frightful Presence 60 ft DC 35. naginata +33 reach 15 (3d8+16 S +1d6 spirit + spirit touch). Divine DC 38: seize soul (x3), execute (x3), scrying, interplanar teleport, spirit blast (x3). Change Shape; Pouch of Four Gems; Release Soul (18d6 emanation DC 38 Fort).

SILSYCHE C6 UNCOMMON KAMI/SPIRIT, lonely spirit of an abandoned home (never wants to harm). AC 23; Fort +14 Ref +17 Will +12; HP 68 rejuvenation; incorporeal, resist all 5. touch +15 agile/finesse (2d8+6 mental). Inhabit Home (can't leave or 3d10 force/rd). Rejuvenation (2d4 days unless home destroyed). Occult DC 24: item facade, illusory object (x3), light. Hallucinatory Home (1/day DC 24 Will, fascinated).

STONE SPIDER C5 RARE CELESTIAL town-gate guardian bonded to a settlement (Willowshore's is UGLY CUTE). AC 22; Fort +10 Ref +12 Will +14; HP 62; immune bleed/disease/paralyzed/petrified/poison; telepathy 60. Bonded Vessel (HP tied to statue; destroyed vessel = permanent death). spirit web +14 range 30 (DC 22); Inhabit Vessel -> stone fangs +14 (2d8+7 P), resist physical 6. Divine DC 21: dream message, forbidding ward, read aura. Reconstitution. MINDSCAPE: Ugly Cute, slain+vessel destroyed in modern era, awakens permanently merged in the mindscape.

THATCHLING C0 UNCOMMON UNDEAD (grass body of a soul denied reincarnation). AC 15; Fort +4 Ref +7 Will +6; HP 16 void healing; weak fire 5, resist bludg/pierce 2. frond +5 agile/finesse (1d6 S). Distracting Giggle aura 15 ft (-1 Will). Rejuvenation (DC 11 unless killed by fire). Thatchling's Curse (DC 16 Will, speed/direction penalty). RED-HOODED variant C2 RARE: AC 17; HP 32; frond +9 (+1d4 bleed); illusory disguise; Create Thatchling Spawn; Howl of Vengeful Fury (30 ft 2d10 sonic, buffs thatchlings). Willowshore's thatchlings are doomed townsfolk reborn each summer.
